forecast_scope: Rounded selected-role research outputs only. Complete journals, private recipe identifiers, feature transforms, calibration parameters, model bodies and raw source responses are excluded.
horizon_note: T60/T120 label nominal research horizons. Actual EARLY_OUTLOOK, NOMINAL and LATE issue classes are retained. LATE still passed the original pregame clock check and does not mean an in-game forecast.

newest_owner_execution.cost_note: Actual billed cost is not established by this publication export.

promotion_note: Exposed historical development; prospective shadow research only. No automatic production promotion or wagering recommendation.
publication_note: See repository commit history for publication status. Generation is not a deployment or promotion claim.
registry_note: Only the actual frozen issuer registry and explicitly qualified native replacements define active roles. A later comparison selection alone does not replace the issuer registry.
selection_policy: For each phase, target, metric role and nominal horizon, select the latest immutable original issue matching the active issuer champion. Separately retain the latest original issue that carried the metric role at issue time. Null current-champion references remain missing. Issue time and registered role are the only ranking inputs; outcomes are not read.
title: Latest available NBA research forecasts and champion roles

unavailable_output_fields.cover_probability: Comparable actual contract line and settlement evidence not admitted by this exporter.
unavailable_output_fields.interval_bounds: No issued interval bounds have been admitted; historical coverage metrics are not per-game issued bounds.
unavailable_output_fields.joint_score_center: No issued joint score center has been admitted; separate target estimates are not combined into a score prediction.

units.margin: Expected home points minus away points
